title: Integer 0 expands as empty value in ? / & / ; expansions
property: a scalar int n expands to its decimal string in query and path-parameter expansion
actual: '?x=' and ';x' (0 is treated as empty string by a truthiness check `if value:`)
evidence: ScalarVariableValue includes int; RFC 6570 only treats the empty string as empty (3.2.7/3.2.8), 0 is defined and stringifies to '0'; other ints like 1 expand correctly.

title: Reserved/fragment expansion skips encoding when value contains any percent-escape
property: output of {+var} contains no characters outside reserved/unreserved/pct-encoded
actual: 'a b%41' (value returned unchanged because unquote(value) != value)
evidence: RFC 6570 3.2.3: reserved expansion passes through only pct-encoded triplets and reserved/unreserved characters; every other character (e.g. space) must be percent-encoded.
